Jackie Parker —

Jackie Parker spent decades at the top of the ladder — SVP at Global Payments ($7.4B NYSE, 27,000 employees), Chief Talent & Diversity Officer, and President of the General Motors Foundation. She shaped succession governance for the top 22 executives and sat in rooms most people only read about.

And then God called her off the ladder. The Assignment Room™ was not born from theory — it was born from that gap between what God showed her and what fear, security, and identity were telling her to protect.

Who This Is For

This is for the woman who has outgrown private clarity.

The Assignment Room™ is for the woman who looks accomplished from the outside — but knows there is something else she is responsible to build. She is not confused. She is not lost. She is delayed.

She does not need another sign, another course, or another conversation about what she already knows. She needs a room that gives her assignment language, structure, and a first documented move.

She has been carrying the assignment privately — in her journal, her prayers, her saved notes — but has not moved.

She has been calling it timing. Or discernment. But the delay is starting to feel expensive.

She is done negotiating. She is ready to move.
